claimBoundary: This fresh six-dialogue gate can establish only whether frame_refuser supplies three distinct, early, guard-eligible public prefixes while prospective frame_defiant controls remain productive jurisdiction disputes without refusal leakage. It cannot establish tutor adaptation, pedagogical-move efficacy, register efficacy, learning outcomes, human validity, or transfer to the cell harness.

requiredBeforeLiveRun: committed prospective-v3 registration and executable zero-call replay
pinned clean post-merge origin/main launch commit and create-once destination
explicit human approval of the exact request digest and 288-attempt ceiling

targetRequirements: frame_jurisdiction_refusal observed by turn 2 in every target dialogue under prospective_v3 semantics
production prefix extractor accepts the trigger before comprehension repair, protected affect, or content-bearing uptake
three target dialogues yield three distinct public-prefix SHA-256 values
exhausted adherence repairs fail with TUTOR_STUB_FRAME_REFUSER_ADHERENCE_EXHAUSTED before an invalid public candidate
controlRequirements: frame_jurisdiction_dispute with explicit reframe, rival or bounded local test, or content-bearing contribution observed by turn 2 in every control dialogue
productive participation takes precedence over partial withholding when both are explicit
explicit withholding without any contract-licensed participation is absent from every control turn
exhausted adherence repairs fail with TUTOR_STUB_FRAME_DEFIANT_ADHERENCE_EXHAUSTED before an invalid public candidate
gates.decisionRule: Complete assembly, all three frame_refuser targets, all three productive frame_defiant controls, all three distinct target-prefix hashes, both typed no-public-candidate exhaustion paths, and the 48-call repair-readiness diagnostic must pass independently. Failure stops the crossed study and returns to profile or measurement repair; register tuning cannot rescue this gate.
